text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Amplitude, frequency, and phase modulation change different carrier properties

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Aligned illustrative traces: fm=1 Hz, fc=12 Hz, carrier amplitude1. FM phase deviation is (Δf/fm)sin(2πfmt); PM phase deviation is kp m(t). Carrier
frequency is deliberately low enough to show cycles. AM envelope remains positive because μ<1.
